description.en: Enables or disables one light slot within a loaded lighting setup.
Handle of the light setup, from CMND_LOAD_LIGHT.
Index of the light slot to configure.
True to enable that light, false to disable it.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Enable/disable a light slot within the loaded lighting setup
CMND_SET_LIGHT_ENABLE(hLight, i, lgt_enable);
